items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: she said, that English fellow, he's walking her home... I said because he walked you home

ctx.x: So it seems on the door, that man on the door, something like a concierge, watches that door and see who comes in and comes out, so my girlfriend she said, you can go visit and do what you wish to do, so she said, that English fellow, he's walking her home and I said "You can do/ well, it seems as though the English fellow walked her home one night and this man comes out of that compartment that he was in with a knife and that Englishman made it. That Englishman like to tore that street up.

So when I come home, the man was downstairs, he was trying to tell me what had happened and so he showed me, begged my pardon, "I'm sorry I didn't catch him, please forgive me. I didn't catch him. I'm sorry." So I didn't know exactly, so she told me, she said why does he want to kill the English-man. I said because he walked you home, he thought that
Englishman was trying to get something good around here, so you know, and everytime that I would go down there with her, the Englishman -- this man would be, (roaring)
